name: Raft Drift
hook: Hook what floats by. Grow the raft. Mind the shark.
how: Throw your hook at planks, barrels and crates drifting past to fill the crew's stash, then spend it on new raft tiles. A shark circles and bites the edge tiles: hook it a few times to chase it off, and stay out of the water.
controls: WASD to walk, click the sea to throw your hook, B to build, or a thumb stick, tap to throw and the BUILD button
uses: The raft is remembered by its crew: whoever comes back first brings back every tile and the crew's stash.
The host's browser drifts the debris, runs the shark and checks every tile built; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
The biggest raft, in tiles, each player has sailed on.
Bot sailors hook debris, build tiles and smack the shark until enough people join.
Every sailor, hook, tile and shark bite shows up for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a fishing rod that catches fish to cook
Add a storm every few minutes with bigger waves
Let players build a sail that steers the raft
